npcs.name: Cassia Dalton
npcs.description: Cassia Dalton is an Astral Elf vengeance keeper whose grief has become a map of names, debts, and unfinished funerary work. From a hidden room in Kharrowfen, she works with the Choral Synod to track killers, monsters, cursed bloodlines, and the old wrongs polite society keeps calling tragedy. She is gracious until the conversation touches her dead, and then every star in her voice goes cold.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Kharrowfen is a City in Drakmorren, under Oligarchy, with severe danger, Underwater without reefs terrain. Local records favor Selfish, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Triton, Merfolk, Locathah, Tamhiogal, Dril'thar — Ocean. Astral Elf reads through the Half-Elf (choose an Elf Bloodline) entry of the race compendium, within Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, marked by Nebyrr. The local form is read through Half-Elf — Astral Elf. Half-elves are dual-natured beings born of human and elven lineage, often balancing ambition with longevity. They tend to struggle with identity but excel at diplomacy, adaptability, and bridging cultures. Table cues: +2 Charisma, +1 to Two Other Ability Scores, Darkvision, Fey Ancestry; starting tendency Neutral - Lawful - Cooperative - Neutral.
rumors: Cassia Dalton knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Nebday.
